report.summary: All three UI failures are the same timeout: GET /books takes longer than the 5 s Playwright navigation limit. The cause is an artificial random delay of 0 to 8 s in app/main.py list_books, which runs on every /books page render, so roughly a third of page loads time out. Fix the app's latency first (remove or bound the sleep), then the tests will stop depending on it.

causes.title: App's /books page sleeps a random 0-8 s, exceeding the 5 s navigation timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database (app/main.py:149-150). render_books() calls list_books() for every /books page render (app/main.py:256), so each GET /books response is delayed by a random amount. tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7 sets the default Playwright timeout to 5000 ms, and BooksPage.open() calls page.goto('/books') with the default 'load' wait (tests/support/pages.py:33-35). Whenever the random delay exceeds about 5 s, goto raises TimeoutError before any test logic runs. That happens roughly 3 times in 8 (about 37%) per page load, so the outcome changes between runs with identical code. This matches the run: all three tests that open /books failed at goto, while test_deleted_book_disappears, which also opens /books, passed. The login tests, which never call list_books, were not in the failure list. The test suite's own comment at tests/ui/conftest.py:6 says nothing in the app should take longer than 5 s, and this delay violates that. The app is the source of the slowness, so this is not a test bug, but it is also not a deterministic product bug because the same code passes on some runs.
evidence: playwright._impl._errors.TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:49185/books", waiting until "load" (test_added_book_is_listed)
app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:250-256: render_books() calls list_books(user["id"]) on every /books render
tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7: page.set_default_timeout(5000) with comment 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s'
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:38-39: test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input calls BooksPage(logged_in_page).open() first; it failed at goto, so its year-validation assertions never ran
Not failing in this run: tests/ui/test_books_ui.py::test_deleted_book_disappears also opens /books and passed, which is consistent with a random delay rather than a deterministic failure
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random time.sleep from list_books in app/main.py, or at least keep it out of the request path. If the sleep is deliberate for simulating slowness, make it opt-in via an env var that tests do not set. Also make the tests tolerant of slow rendering: use a longer timeout for the books navigation (e.g. page.goto(..., timeout=15000) or a wait for a stable element like get_by_test_id('current-user')) rather than relying on the 5 s default. Re-run the UI suite several times to confirm the timeouts stop appearing.
